scope: Repaired caption-v2 candidates. No playback backend, MPEG conversion, film, VCE or normal deployment changes.

aribb24.distributionDelta: One generated-distribution commit after the source candidate. Source and build configuration are unchanged.
sourceCommitPurposes: Preserve caption state across buffered seeks, with inclusive range queries and packet deduplication in the same commit
Retain native HLS captions across track updates
Release renderer images and report Worker failures
Prune history outside retained video buffers
Repaint complete caption pictures after renderer changes

konomitv.dplayerBaseNote: The DPlayer base also contains the existing post-v1.33.2 danmaku font-size fix from PR #81

contracts.seekReplay: Same-group management retransmissions do not create a new caption-picture boundary
contracts.pictureOwner: aribb24.js Controller; SBTVD replacement clears every renderer, including the DPlayer snapshot observer
contracts.bufferEviction: Release obsolete packets and images before the earliest retained video range, preserving the full active picture and its management context. Unknown boundaries are not replaced with a fixed-size cap
contracts.delayedCues: Reconcile late-inserted past cues, hidden playback and PTS/DTS page boundaries without restoring captions from an excluded video range
contracts.snapshot: The recipient owns and closes returned ImageBitmaps
contracts.captureFailure: Report failed caption/superimpose snapshots and save valid video with any remaining valid layers. Video acquisition failure remains fatal
contracts.workerFailure: Report a failed Worker and restore main-thread rendering with caption visibility and current-picture state preserved
contracts.gitCacheIdentity: Full-SHA git+https specifications and matching locks distinguish Git commits even when package versions are unchanged
contracts.upstreamAdoption: The aribb24 source branch excludes generated dist. Adopt dependencies in order, then pin each upstream-maintained release or SHA; distribution is a fork-only Git-consumption artifact

aribb24.eachSourceCommit: All 7 source trees passed their then-current tests and tsc. Reworded publication commits have identical trees at every step
